description: Matches a business profile against ACOA and Nova Scotia programs read from official pages: province, sector, annual revenue band, employee count, and project type, all optional. Returns each program with source links, checked date, key criteria, status, and a plain fit reason. Likely fit means confirm with the program. Phoenix cannot decide eligibility. Read only.

project_type.description: Allowed: startup, expansion, technology-adoption, ai-adoption, innovation-rd, export, hiring, training.

province.description: Province or territory code or name, such as NS or Nova Scotia. Omit for the published summary.

revenue_band.description: Annual revenue. Allowed: pre-revenue, under-1m, 1m-10m, over-10m.

sector.description: Allowed: agri-food, manufacturing, digital, ocean, clean-tech, tourism, services, retail, other.

name: funding_eligibility_check
title: Funding eligibility check
